series: JLPT N3 grammar series; denominator = 220 Bunpro N3 entries (n3-coverage-matrix, frozen)
levelPolicy: Bunpro precedence (docs/jlpt-levels.md); Rule A owning level kept for reused items; new items classified by the complete visible contrast; Rule B both Sensei and SKM at N3; Rule C N2 only where the exact sense is supported at N2 and N3 placement cannot be verified.

primarySources.use: N3 なかなか〜ない 'not easily, hardly'; often something expected that does not happen (yet).
N3 全く〜ない 'not at all'; more serious than 全然.
N3 とても〜ない: impossibility, mainly with potential verbs.
N3 別に〜ない 'not particularly'; verb, adjective and noun structures.
N3 決して〜ない 'never, by no means'.
N3 めったに〜ない 'rarely'; Verb-ない and Noun は めったにない; kana spelling more common.
N3 必ずしも with わけではない / とは限らない / とは言えない.
N3 どうしても 'no matter what': wishes (どうしても〜たい) and negatives (どうしても治らない).

supplementarySources.supports: Reviewed seed items for めったに, 決して, 必ずしも and 別に; adapted (frequency, promise, generalisation and film-verdict stems).

dispositions.note: Wish (たい), obligation (なければならない) and negative (行けない). concert-wish and meeting-must are collocation-recognition items decided by the printed ending; party-decline is decided by the context. なかなか is withheld as a distractor where its 'not easily' sense is natural; とても is withheld before たい and なければならない. 如何しても is accepted as a rare typed spelling.

levelNotes: All 31 items are jlpt 3: every selection item decides between N3 adverbs, and interpretation items require reading an N3 adverb. No Rule C (N2) labels were needed.

reviewLimits: No physical-device rendering check was performed.
Model-authored; independent model reviews recorded by the coordinator.

independentReview.method: Three blind single-facet reviews, each by a fresh agent with a different requested model family, given only the frozen render, raw set JSON, article and ledger: A linguistic correctness, B consistency and quiz safety, C learner comprehensibility. Findings were consolidated by the coordinator, applied by the author, and sent back to the original reviewers for a per-finding disposition.
independentReview.actualModelNote: The runtime does not expose the served model; the requested model is recorded.

reviews.finalVerdict: all findings resolved after two rounds; no new findings

findings.claim: 'Only どうしても combines with 〜たい or 〜なければならない' was overstated: とても行きたい is ordinary 'very' plus a wish.
findings.change: Reworded: of these three, only どうしても pairs with 〜たい or 〜なければならない to mean 'at any cost'; とても行きたい is ordinary 'very', not とても〜ない; なかなか combines with neither ending.

findings.claim: '…but the bus did come' did not explain why どうしても fails.
findings.change: Rationale now says どうしても〜ない stresses that every attempt fails, nobody tried anything here, and a bus slow to come that finally arrived is the 'not easily' sense of なかなか.

findings.location: locked-door (round 2; an item added for NPA-B-02)
findings.claim: 押しても引いてもなかなか開かない is a normal collocation, so なかなか was not clearly wrong.
findings.change: Item dropped; laundry-slow (なかなか keyed against どうしても) added in its place.

reviews.finalVerdict: all findings resolved; no new findings

findings.claim: The offered option subset predicted the key: めったに／なかなか were never keyed in two-option items, and 決して／とても never in three-option items.
findings.change: All items in both relationships are now two-option, each pair keyed both ways (決して removed from eating-out and lecture, 全く from new-year-drink and cheap-ticket, とても from late-bus and meeting-must, どうしても from leg-injury); n3check reports no option-inventory or answer-position warnings.

findings.claim: The printed ending, not the context, decides these items; only party-decline decides どうしても by context.
findings.change: Kept as collocation-recognition items. A context-decided locked-door item was tried and then dropped after NPA-A-03; laundry-slow rebalances the pair.
findings.disposition: accepted as collocation recognition; party-decline remains the context-decided どうしても item

findings.claim: The kanji spelling 如何しても was not accepted.
findings.change: 如何しても accepted as a typed answer, never shown as an option.

reviews.finalVerdict: all findings resolved; no new findings

findings.claim: The article said 必ずしも 'usually needs' a partial-denial ending, which conflicts with old-clock's plain negative.
findings.change: 〜ない added to the 必ずしも endings; §3 example 家族でも、意見は必ずしも一致しない with reading and English; the confusion bullet says an ordinary negative also works and keeps 'usually' for とは限らない／わけではない.

findings.claim: The six interpretation examples lacked kana readings.
findings.change: Reading column added for all six sentences.
